_about: H-taste -> the sore spots (1 Oct play-test D15e, decision 27; js/clinic/heal/games/taste.js). Pop the spots of the colour(s) said with a cotton bud dipped in a soothing ointment (never a pin), the others stay; then one named drink (a liquid poured, one thing added, stirred, given) clears the rest. Levels are data: pop (colours to pop; L3 every colour but the one said, na), each (spots of each popping colour), decoys (spots of each other colour), upMs (how long a spot stays up), maxUp (spots up at once), counts (spoons of the drink's thing, from L2). The colours are data/clinic.json's col-* words (English placeholders, to record). art: the art plan's M2 tongue, O2 spots and O3 bud swap in by file name once ready.

1._note: one colour to pop (of three), then the drink with no count; the first play is the guided round (D13)

2._note: two colours, the drink with a spoon count (written)

3._note: not the colour said (na): pop the other two; faster; heard only (the closed card)

art._about: art plan pack clinic-heal-v3 (M2, O2, O3): used once ready is true ({kind} = the patient's kind); box = x, y, w, h in the close-up's 800x500 units

camera._about: D2 (1 Oct): the wide shot the zoom starts from, chosen by the angle the close-up needs (front-on or side-on). No side-on sitting pose exists yet: 'side' uses the front pose until the art batch (art list A1).
